coverage.front_facing_readers: Eight broad Gauss Werke reader PDFs plus current focused Band II source-checked readers and pilot passage readers.
coverage.status: Current cumulative rebuild incorporates the latest local repair pass: Disquisitiones Arithmeticae fills, Band I alternate expansion, Band II quadratic reciprocity and Seeber identity repairs, Band III AGM repairs, Band VI chapters 8, 10, 11, and 13 repairs, Band VII chapter and article repairs, and Band XI Part I recovery.
coverage.not_yet_front_facing: Other Gauss volumes and chapters remain in source/provenance or repair queues until they can be assembled into usable readers.
coverage.current_band_ii_pilot: Four direct pilot readers preserve Latin/German source text and English translations for Theorematis arithmetici demonstratio nova Articles 5-7 and the Seeber identity passage. The current Band II source-checked cumulative readers now extend through Articles 30-76, the following notices, and the first Latin Nachlass section through printed page 211, with a German translation track for the Latin Nachlass.
